title: Order and qualified direction required.
bodyText: No person shall practice respiratory care under this chapter except under the order and qualified direction of a physician or an osteopathic physician licensed pursuant to chapter 453, a physician assistant licensed pursuant to chapter 453, or an advanced practice registered nurse licensed pursuant to chapter 457.
bodyHtml: §466D-4  Order and qualified direction required.  No person shall practice respiratory care under this chapter except under the order and qualified direction of a physician or an osteopathic physician licensed pursuant to chapter 453, a physician assistant licensed pursuant to chapter 453, or an advanced practice registered nurse licensed pursuant to chapter 457. [L 2010, c 178, pt of §2; am L 2023, c 102, §3]
